t: This is the Michael Faraday Memorial, a monument to the Victorian scientist, standing in Elephant Square at Elephant and Castle. Faraday was an English chemist and physicist with little formal education. He became one of the most influential scientists in history. His discoveries include the principles behind electromagnetic induction and electrolysis, and he established the concept of the electromagnetic field. The memorial was designed by the architect Rodney Gordon. Gordon worked mainly in concrete, and his buildings have been called dramatic, sculptural and futuristic.
